notes: The generation models of the art round, by the group keys of art-prompts/generate.mjs and art-prompts/v2/gen-candidate.mjs: the served repository, the weights, the licence id and the verdicts of docs/dev/art-provenance.md section 2 (R3-05, licences read 2026-10-17). The ingest tool copies `id`, `weights` and `licence` into every .art.json source it writes; the origin report joins a record's licence ids with the verdicts here. When a verdict changes, change it here and in art-provenance.md together.

flux1.conditions: only in the free open-source (MPL-2.0) distribution, never sold — the owner's ruling of 2026-10-23 (art-provenance.md section 8, decision 1); any paid or commercial distribution needs a BFL commercial licence (bfl.ai/licensing) first

sd35.conditions: only after the Stability AI registration, while the licensee group earns under USD 1 M a year (art-provenance.md section 6, rule 2)

qwenvl.conditions: after the content review (art-provenance.md section 6, rule 3)

qwenedit.conditions: after the content review; an edit of a FLUX image inherits FLUX's non-commercial basis (art-provenance.md section 8, decision 1)
